EC1: Vaccination [AND] against pneumococcal infection in anamnesis;
EC2: Application of preparations of immune globulin [OR] or blood transfusion within last three months prior to clinical studies;
EC3: Prolonged use (more than 14 days) immunosuppressants [OR] or other immunosuppressive drugs within 6 months prior to the start of the study;
EC4: Any confirmed or suspected immunosuppressive [OR] or immunodeficient condition, including HIV infection;
EC5: A history or currently hematologic and other cancers;
EC6: A positive reaction for [OR] HIV infection, viral hepatitis B and hepatitis C;
EC7: The presence of respiratory [OR], cardio-vascular insufficiency [OR], impaired [OR] liver and kidney function, established during a physical examination at visit number 1;
EC8: Pronounced congenital defects [OR] or serious chronic diseases in the acute stage, including any clinically important exacerbation [OR] of chronic diseases of the liver, kidney, cardiovascular, nervous system [OR], mental diseases [OR] or metabolic disorders, confirmed by the history or objective examination (pulmonary: cystic fibrosis [OR], lung abscess [OR], empyema [OR], active tuberculosis [OR]; extra-pulmonary: congestive heart failure [OR], malabsorption [OR], chronic renal and hepatic failure [OR], cirrhosis [OR], malignancy [OR], immunodeficiency [OR], cirrhosis of the liver);
EC9: Severe allergic reactions in anamnesis of autoimmune disease;
EC10: The presence of acute infectious and/or communicable illnesses within 1 month prior to study;
EC11: History of chronic alcohol abuse [OR] and/or drug use;
EC15: Participation in any other clinical study within the last 3 months.
